_note: Hannah Gadsby's own stand-up jokes from Nanette (2018), setup and punchline kept as separate lines. Used by Next Top Comic's shared pool (data/next_top_comic.json 'sources').

jokes.setup: For a long time, I knew more facts about unicorns than I did about lesbians.
jokes.punchline: There are no facts about unicorns.
jokes.note: Both lines verbatim in the transcript (an aside sits between them on stage).

jokes.setup: I just don't think there was enough lesbian content.
jokes.punchline: I'd been on stage the whole time.
jokes.note: Verbatim in the transcript (the setup is the audience member's feedback as Gadsby quotes it).

jokes.setup: No, Grandma. No, I don't have time for boyfriends.
jokes.punchline: But if I had time, heaps!

jokes.setup: I cook dinner way more than I lesbian.
jokes.punchline: But nobody ever introduces me as 'that chef comedian,' do they?
jokes.note: Verbatim in the transcript except its typo 'nobody every introduces', kept as 'ever'.

jokes.setup: Would you put a bangle on a potato?
jokes.punchline: No, that's organic. I paid a lot for that potato.
jokes.note: Verbatim in the transcript ('would' mid-sentence there).

_jokes_verification.method: Jokes from a stand-up special: the special is the primary source and a full transcript of it is the text checked. On 2026-10-23 each transcript page was downloaded as raw HTML and each joke's setup and punchline were string-matched against the page text, ignoring only quote-mark/dash/ellipsis typography and sentence-initial capitals; the setup/punchline split is ours. Wording was not checked against the special's audio. Lines found only on aggregators (quote wikis, listicles) or that the transcript does not carry verbatim are verified=false and stay out of the comic's pool.
_jokes_verification.rule: Only jokes with verified=true are in Next Top Comic's pool (tests/test_quotes_vv.gd).
